'''2002 Atlanta DPC''' was a Star Wars CCG DPC held in War Room, Atlanta, Georgia in April 2002. [[Paul Myers]] won it. It is known from Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3633">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-02-never-tell-me-the-odds-atl-dpc-by-myersd3633/ never-tell-me-the-odds-atl-dpc-by-myers], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 2 May 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-02-never-tell-me-the-odds-atl-dpc-by-myersd3633/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' April 2002
* '''Site:''' War Room, Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Myers]]
